caption:
Swipe to see five things Claude handles for your business tonight: proposals, pricing formulas, performance reviews, sales assets, and your FAQ page. 🔑

1. Turn a 90-second voice memo into a full client proposal with three pricing tiers, 2. build a pricing formula for Excel by describing your costs in plain sentences, 3. write a formal performance review from a set of rough bullet notes, 4. turn one client success story into five sales assets including a testimonial email, LinkedIn post, website quote, sales talking point, and pitch deck paragraph, 5. write your full FAQ page from a list of your most common client questions.

Every task here is a job most business owners pay someone else to do or skip because it takes too long. Anthropic paused AI training this week because progress is moving faster than expected. The floor keeps rising. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this looks like for yours.

hook_sharpen.why: "YOU'VE BEEN PAYING" makes it instantly personal—the reader recognizes themselves being called out for wasting money, a gut-level emotional trigger that stops scrolls harder than [0]'s impressive but more detached "IN ONE PROMPT" detail. [0] is close, but comparing agency fees to Claude hits harder when YOU are the target, not agencies.
